notes.title: Thank you for 500 downloads of the trial version🙇‍♂️
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Misato from OUDENEI.

First of All
It has been a week since the release of the demo version, and we’ve achieved 500 downloads!

I’m truly delighted that so many people have taken an interest in a game I initially created to promote my novel.

If you’d like to dive deeper into the world of the game, please check out the original story, Error Code: 99. It’s a cyberpunk tale interwoven with the themes of shrine maidens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439380/ea32408d7daf8a35c4a2f8ba7ea4d01ae28b2d40.png

If you come across any bugs, I’d greatly appreciate it if you could report them on the following forum:
Bug Report

You can also report issues via X (formerly Twitter), my Discord server, or even in the chat on Twitch.

When reporting on X, please include the hashtag #エラーコード九十九.

About the Full Version
The full version is currently in development and is scheduled for release in March.

It will feature:

3 maps to explore
4 different endings
A significant amount of text, ensuring a rich and immersive experience
That said, there are also elements that won’t make it into the final game. I’ve compiled these details into the roadmap below for your reference.

■ Planned Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439380/a2f62d1b86063294c3e5b0b12e7a5ba4d16a6e43.png

■ Unfeasible Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439380/792e9f41cba571de1c50df2cafb5206c968cd152.png

If you have any other requests or suggestions, feel free to share them directly or via X. (Though, due to budget constraints, I might have to decline some requests…)

I’m grateful for any feedback, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts!

I hope you continue to enjoy the games and worlds created by OUDENEI.
Thank you for your ongoing support!

Lastly, please check out another game I’ve released, 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3213380/_cursed_letter/
